content: Mobilizon (Framasoft to 2024, Kaihuri 2025+): federated events and groups; docs list share/report/edit event, comments, participant management, moderation guide, auto-generated newsletter, RSS/Atom and ICS/WebCal feeds, event import, embed in WordPress/websites, GraphQL API, federation with Gancio. Calagator (Portland tech calendar, MIT): site-wide iCalendar and Atom subscribe feeds, per-event .ics and Google Calendar TEMPLATE link, hCalendar, import events, venues, tags, admin-only duplicates squash tool at /events/duplicates.
